intro: The Call of Earth is an elemental trial undertaken by spiritual initiates to prove their steadfastness. By retrieving requested materials, the petitioner demonstrates their grit and determination to their instructor. Successfully enduring the task confirms their readiness to proceed to the next stage of their training.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, friend.
